summary: Gold and stealth civ. Pit Mines make gold without running out, Cattle replace hunting, and Musofadi units can ambush from stealth.

spikes.label: Javelins and Musofadi
spikes.detail: Javelin Throwers beat archers, and Musofadi Warriors ambush from stealth.
spikes.answer: Men-at-Arms and horsemen; scout for hidden units near your lines.

spikes.label: Fast veteran upgrades
spikes.detail: Veteran upgrades are half cost and time, so their army upgrades quickly.

spikes.label: Musofadi Gunners
spikes.answer: Fight before Imperial if you can.
